title: Build and verify a portable workflow

slides.title: Make the contract executable
body: Week 10 / H2 / guided studio
Turn the declared protocol into a portable package.
slides.teach: H2 provides15minutes explanation followed by45minutes guided computing. The evidence target is a verified handover ZIP plus a fresh-process prediction comparison. The complete walkthrough requires free CPU only.

slides.title: Inspect the retained packaged fixture
body: 442 observations, ten raw numeric inputs.
Use scaled=False; this is a statistical workflow exercise.
slides.teach: Explain why the loader’s globally scaled defaults would obscure the intended training-only fit boundary. Do not assign clinical interpretations to these input coordinates.
slides.visual_scope: Native teaching diagram or actual fitted-function evidence

slides.title: Freeze the three cohorts by source ID
body: 265 training + 88 validation + 89 test = 442.
Keep membership with the frozen records.
slides.teach: One tile represents one source observation. The saved IDs are dataset-version-specific and not features.
slides.visual_scope: Native teaching diagram or actual fitted-function evidence

slides.title: Validation fixes the candidate before test inspection
body: Median, Ridge 1, Ridge 20, Ridge 100.
Exact ties follow this declared order.
slides.teach: The replay refits only the saved selected candidate on training rows. It does not redo selection or fit on train plus validation.
slides.visual_scope: Native teaching diagram or actual fitted-function evidence

slides.title: A new interpreter removes notebook state
body: It cannot access a notebook’s fitted model or arrays.
It still shares the installed environment.
slides.teach: We copy the complete bundle and use sys.executable -I from a fresh working directory. This does not isolate the OS, installed dependencies or data source.
slides.visual_scope: Native teaching diagram or actual fitted-function evidence

slides.title: Align observations before comparing predictions
body: The first reference value must refer to the first saved test ID.
Never sort predictions independently of IDs.
slides.teach: Same membership alone is insufficient. The runner checks the exact ID sequence before numeric agreement.
slides.visual_scope: Native teaching diagram or actual fitted-function evidence

slides.title: Use a transparent tolerance rule
body: Allow atol + rtol * abs(reference).
Tolerance is not a model-accuracy metric.
slides.teach: We use atol1e-8 and rtol1e-10. The widget fixes a reference prediction10, so the limit is1.1e-8. Students test differences on either side of the limit. A loose tolerance can hide a broken replay; it should not be tuned to force a pass.

slides.title: Task 3: open one complete notebook
body: Keep the same notebook for Tasks 1–8.
If the runtime resets, run again from Setup.
slides.teach: Choose the complete Exercise or the worked alternative. H1Tasks1–2 are already in the same file; do not repeat another walkthrough.
slides.visual_scope: Native teaching diagram or actual fitted-function evidence

slides.title: Check raw columns and saved membership
body: IDs are not model features.
Only the declared ten raw columns enter the pipeline.
slides.teach: Check shape, finite values, canonical feature order and 265/88/89 cohort IDs before model fitting.
slides.visual_scope: Native teaching diagram or actual fitted-function evidence

slides.title: Fit four predeclared candidates
body: The median uses training targets only.
Each Ridge scaler and coefficient fit training rows only.
slides.teach: Training minimizes its objective; validation MAE chooses the candidate. A baseline can legitimately win.
slides.visual_scope: Native teaching diagram or actual fitted-function evidence

slides.title: Read the actual validation comparison
body: Choose the lowest validation MAE.
Save the winner before displaying final-test outcomes.
slides.teach: Use actual run values rather than promise Ridge20 will always win. The reference choice is recorded beside the environment.

slides.title: Read shrinkage separately from validation MAE
body: The coefficient norm describes the fitted parameter size.
A smaller norm need not mean a better validation score.
slides.teach: The horizontal axis is log alpha. Do not equate regularization strength with a monotonic held-out score improvement.

slides.title: Keep the validation decision frozen
body: Task 3 ends with selected_before_test.
Test outcomes cannot reopen this choice.
slides.teach: Inspect the actual validation dropdown. It reports each declared candidate; it does not mutate the stored winner.

slides.title: Review the program another process will run
body: Verify → read schema → restore IDs → fit → compare reference.
The source is visible and reviewable in the notebook.
slides.teach: The source cell writes replay.py and imports functions but does not fit. Expand it and locate the ID-sequence and assert_allclose calls.
slides.visual_scope: Native teaching diagram or actual fitted-function evidence

slides.title: Task 4: reject malformed temporary copies
body: Test the schema reader directly before fitting.
Keep the reference folder unchanged.
slides.teach: Expected caught ValueErrors are observations, not notebook crashes. Unexpected acceptance must stop the exercise.
slides.visual_scope: Native teaching diagram or actual fitted-function evidence

slides.title: An ID must identify one row only
body: A duplicated or empty ID breaks the identity contract.
Record the specific rejection reason.
slides.teach: Create a copied malformed fixture. The reference source ID mapping stays unchanged; no model fitting is used for this contract test.
slides.visual_scope: Native teaching diagram or actual fitted-function evidence

slides.title: A finite rectangular matrix is required
body: Reject NaN and rows with missing or extra values.
Do not silently drop a malformed observation.
slides.teach: The contract is an interface promise. A well-formed finite value can still be scientifically wrong.
slides.visual_scope: Native teaching diagram or actual fitted-function evidence

slides.title: Column order is part of a positional interface
body: A strict header check rejects an unexpected order.
An explicit name adapter is a separate, tested operation.
slides.teach: OptionalB reconstructs the canonical order by names, then checks exact parsed values. It does not waive the strict input contract.
slides.visual_scope: Native teaching diagram or actual fitted-function evidence

slides.title: Disjointness alone does not establish a partition
body: Check counts, no overlaps and the full ID union.
Missing or repeated membership must be rejected.
slides.teach: One ID placed in both train and test fails; an omitted ID also fails. A set check cannot by itself identify duplicates inside a list.
slides.visual_scope: Native teaching diagram or actual fitted-function evidence

slides.title: Read the actual rejection outcomes
body: Seven malformed cases should be rejected.
A caught expected error is a successful contract check.
slides.teach: DuplicateID, NaN, header order, extra/missing values, emptyID and invalid partition are tested. They are not performance evaluations.

slides.title: Task 5: evaluate the frozen choice once
body: Compare the selected candidate with the median baseline.
Then preserve the rows and procedure for replay.
slides.teach: Test outcomes now become visible. Report the actual selected candidate and baseline on the same89 observations without changing the validation winner.

slides.title: Locate one actual prediction failure
body: Read prediction minus observed target.
Keep the source ID with the case.
slides.teach: A positive residual is overprediction. Show one actual large error from the exported row table; do not infer medical causation from that row.

slides.title: Do not confuse two kinds of error
body: Prediction error compares a model with outcomes.
Replay difference compares two computations.
slides.teach: A numerically perfect replay can preserve a poor prediction. The measured target error is not zero just because the recomputation agrees.
slides.visual_scope: Native teaching diagram or actual fitted-function evidence

slides.title: Give the receiver six payload files and a manifest
body: CSV, split, config, reference predictions, source and result.
Save hashes before executing the copy.
slides.teach: The six payload files are hashed individually. The manifest is the seventh file. It is unsigned and not self-authenticating.
slides.visual_scope: Native teaching diagram or actual fitted-function evidence

slides.title: Copy the bundle into a fresh working directory
body: Start a separate Python interpreter on that copy.
Its only inputs are the handover path and output path.
slides.teach: The child process ID differs from the notebook’s ID. It uses the same installed Python environment; do not call it an independent environment.
slides.visual_scope: Native teaching diagram or actual fitted-function evidence

slides.title: The runner must read its own reference predictions
body: Check the saved test-ID sequence before numeric values.
The notebook does not supply its arrays to the child.
slides.teach: The updated runner reads reference-predictions.csv itself, checks observed targets and predicts with the refitted selected candidate. It can report agreement after extraction without a notebook parent.
slides.visual_scope: Native teaching diagram or actual fitted-function evidence

slides.title: Compare all 89 aligned prediction differences
body: Use the declared absolute and relative tolerance.
Investigate a mismatch before changing the tolerance.
slides.teach: This plot has a fixed zero-centered vertical scale. It measures computation difference, not model error against outcomes.

slides.title: Try the receiver path after ZIP extraction
body: Review replay.py, then execute it using the extracted folder.
Check its JSON comparison result without notebook memory.
slides.teach: Instructor QA extracts the actual ZIP and runs the child in a fresh directory. Students should identify the same six payloads and the standalone reference comparison.
slides.visual_scope: Native teaching diagram or actual fitted-function evidence

slides.title: Summary: make the procedure travel
body: Saved identity, declared choices, explicit contracts.
A new process can check its own reference predictions.
slides.teach: Retrieve the exact inputs, validation decision, reader checks and comparison scope. No clinical or deployment validity follows from replay agreement.
slides.visual_scope: Native teaching diagram or actual fitted-function evidence

slides.title: Exit: what is removed and what is still shared?
body: Notebook variables are removed; installed packages remain shared.
Keep the same notebook for the H3 row-reorder experiment.
slides.teach: Finish Task5 before proceeding to Task6. Preserve the original bundle unchanged so the next controlled comparison has a fixed reference.
slides.visual_scope: Native teaching diagram or actual fitted-function evidence
